'''The Admiral Now thats not a deck you see every day...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The Admiral]]
* '''Published:''' 9 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif|label=Agents In The Court}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents In The Court
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Court Admiral LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

the weirdest deck youve ever seen that actually works.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

start HFTMF for Insurrection combo, seekin an audience, and staging areas. occupy AC and one of the other two(if not both) to flip. drain at the sites you control, added to by Tessek. cancel to force drains a turn with the objective and Bargaining Table.use Revolution and Obis Apparition to choke opponents activation, while using Careful Planning and staging areas, etc, to raise yours. win by causing tons of direct damage and a good unmodifiable drain at the tat sites(again, added to by Tessek, Lightsaber Pro).
